-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.bbolt.Logger` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def bbolt.boltLogMethods : List GoString :=
  [go!"Debugf", go!"Errorf",
    go!"Infof", go!"Warningf"]

def bbolt.fmtVerbs : GoString → Option (List w8) :=
  List.brecOn x✝ bbolt.fmtVerbs._f

def bbolt.logArgOk (R : IProp GF) (v : w8) : GoInterface → IProp GF :=
  match x✝ with
  | GoInterface.nil => iprop(True)
  | GoInterface.ok ii =>
    iprop(⌜fmt.ArgWf ii⌝ ∨
        ⌜v ∈ bbolt.methodVerbs⌝ ∗ fmtErrorOk (GoInterface.ok ii) ∨
          ⌜methodSet ii.ty !! go!"Format" = none ∧
                  methodSet ii.ty !! go!"Error" ≠ some noArgStringSig ∧
                    methodSet ii.ty !! go!"String" = some noArgStringSig ∧
                      v ∈ bbolt.methodVerbs⌝ ∗
              bbolt.stringMethodWith R ii go!"String" ∨
            ∃ s b,
              ⌜ii.ty = go.byte.SliceType ∧ ii.v = intoVal s⌝ ∗ □ (R -∗ ∃ dq, ownSlice s b dq ∗ (ownSlice s b dq -∗ R)))

def bbolt.boltLogger (l : GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  match l with
  | GoInterface.nil => iprop(False)
  | GoInterface.ok li =>
    iprop(□
        ∀ m fmtS vs args xs dq R,
          ⌜m ∈ bbolt.boltLogMethods ∧ bbolt.fmtVerbs fmtS = some vs ∧ vs.length = xs.length⌝ -∗
            □
              ∀ Φ,
                ownSlice args xs dq ∗ ([∗list] p ∈ vs.zip xs, bbolt.logArgOk R p.fst p.snd) ∗ R -∗
                  ▷ (ownSlice args xs dq ∗ R -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗
                    WP (((intoVal (methods li.ty m li.v)) (intoVal fmtS)) (intoVal args)) {{ Φ }})

def bbolt.methodVerbs : List w8 :=
  [W8 115, W8 118, W8 113, W8 120]

def bbolt.logVerbs : List w8 :=
  [W8 115, W8 118, W8 113, W8 100, W8 116, W8 120]

theorem bbolt.boltLogger_persistent (l : GoInterface) : Persistent (bbolt.boltLogger l)

def bbolt.stringMethodWith (R : IProp GF) (ii : GoInterfaceOk) (m : GoString) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(□ ∀ Φ, R -∗ (▷ ∀ s, R -∗ Φ (intoVal s)) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods ii.ty m ii.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }})
